transcript.content:
<issue>
会话锁导致并发消息丢弃：连续发送多条消息只处理第一条
## 问题描述

当用户快速连续发送多条消息（如多张图片）时，cc-connect 只处理第一条，其余消息在会话锁定期间被静默丢弃，session 解锁后也不会补处理。

## 日志证据

```
20:45:17.184 downloaded image  size=244513   ← 第1张，成功下载
20:45:17.184 processing message              ← 第1张，进入处理
20:45:17.195 interactive session started     ← session 被锁
20:45:17.389 message received                ← 第2张消息到达
20:45:17.916 downloaded image  size=266337   ← 第2张，成功下载
20:45:18.003 message received                ← 第3张消息到达
20:45:18.629 downloaded image  size=680155   ← 第3张，成功下载
20:45:47.738 turn complete                   ← 第1张处理完毕
（之后无任何 processing message — 第2、3张被丢弃）
```

## 使用场景

报销场景中员工需要一次性发送多张发票/付款截图。当前只能逐张发送并等待机器人回复后再发下一张，体验很差。

## 期望行为

会话锁定期间收到的消息应该排队等待，session 解锁后依次处理，而不是丢弃。

## 环境

- cc-connect 版本：1.2.1
- 平台：feishu（WebSocket 模式）
- Agent：claudecode

</issue>

The repository is at /testbed.

Report the code (with line numbers) of that function (processInteractiveMessage or similar), the Session struct's TryLock/Unlock in core/session.go, and any existing queue fields.

content.content: {"summary":"The premise is incorrect: when the session is locked, core/engine.go does not drop the incoming message. It tries to queue it (up to maxQueuedMessages) for the running turn, and only replies \"previous processing\" if queueing fails. The lock-check site is in handleMessage (not processInteractiveMessage), which spawns processInteractiveMessageWith. Session.TryLock/Unlock are simple busy-flag operations under s.mu. The existing queue is interactiveState.pendingMessages.","findings":["core/engine.go:1324 func (e *Engine) handleMessage(p Platform, msg *Message) contains the session lock check.","core/engine.go:1470-1472: session := sessions.GetOrCreateActive(msg.SessionKey); if !session.TryLock() { ... }","core/engine.go:1492-1494: when locked, e.queueMessageForBusySession(p, msg, interactiveKey) is called to queue the message for the running turn.","core/engine.go:1497-1502: race guard; if the queue append succeeded and session.TryLock() now succeeds, it starts go e.drainOrphanedQueue(...) (defined at line 1621).","core/engine.go:1505-1506: only if queueing fails does it call e.reply(... MsgPreviousProcessing) and return, so the message is dropped only in that case.","core/engine.go:1517-1519: when unlocked, it proceeds to go e.processInteractiveMessageWith(...) (defined at line 1897); processInteractiveMessage is at line 1889.","core/engine.go:1575-1600 func queueMessageForBusySession: returns false if there is no alive agentSession, or if len(state.pendingMessages) >= maxQueuedMessages; otherwise appends a queuedMessage under state.mu. The message is not sent to agent stdin at queue time.","core/engine.go:26: const maxQueuedMessages = 5.","core/engine.go:242-252: type queuedMessage struct {platform, replyCtx, content, images, files, fromVoice, userID, msgPlatform, msgSessionKey}.","core/engine.go:264: interactiveState.pendingMessages []queuedMessage, the existing queue field, with mu sync.Mutex at line 259.","core/engine.go:1472-1490: /btw handling. When locked and the message is a /btw command, it sends the text into the running agentSession via Send() instead of queueing.","core/session.go:31-39 func (s *Session) TryLock() bool: under s.mu, returns false if s.busy, else sets busy=true and returns true.","core/session.go:41-43 func (s *Session) Unlock() calls s.unlock(true); core/session.go:45-47 UnlockWithoutUpdate() calls s.unlock(false).","core/session.go:49-56 unlock(update bool): under s.mu sets busy=false and, if update is true, sets UpdatedAt=time.Now().","core/session.go:18-29 Session struct has mu sync.Mutex and busy bool fields.   1572  // session is busy. The message is NOT sent to agent stdin at queue time;

  1574  // Returns true if the message was successfully queued, false otherwise.
  1575  func (e *Engine) queueMessageForBusySession(p Platform, msg *Message, interactiveKey string) bool {

content.content: {"summary":"e.interactiveStates[key] is written only inside getOrCreateInteractiveStateWith, under interactiveMu. The map entry is created before agent start succeeds, and agentSession is set once at construction, never reassigned. pendingMessages is drained in three places: drainPendingMessages, an inline dequeue in processInteractiveEvents, and a call from a busy-session path at line 1640.","findings":["processInteractiveMessageWith (engine.go:1897) calls getOrCreateInteractiveStateWith at line 1917 (`state := e.getOrCreateInteractiveStateWith(interactiveKey, ...)`), then returns early at 1938-1940 if `state.agentSession == nil` (reply MsgFailedToStartAgentSession).","getOrCreateInteractiveStateWith (engine.go:2117) takes e.interactiveMu (2118-2119). Reuse path at 2121-2126: if existing state has a live agentSession and its CurrentSessionID matches session.GetAgentSessionID(), it returns that state. Mismatch path at 2128-2150: markStopped, closeAgentSessionWithTimeout, then `delete(e.interactiveStates, sessionKey)` at 2148.","Key set, context-canceled path (engine.go:2194-2196): `state = &interactiveState{platform: p, replyCtx: replyCtx}` with nil agentSession, stored in e.interactiveStates[sessionKey] before any agent start is attempted.","Key set, start-failure path (engine.go:2222-2225): after agent.StartSession fails, including the fresh-session fallback at 2214, a nil-agentSession state is stored in the map at 2224 and returned.","Key set, success path (engine.go:2238-2243): agent.StartSession(e.ctx, startSessionID) at 2205 succeeds, then state = &interactiveState{agentSession: agentSession, ...} at 2238-2241 and e.interactiveStates[sessionKey] = state at 2243. agentSession is therefore set in the same step the key is inserted, after the session has started. The only assignments to state.agentSession are in these literals; there is no later `state.agentSession =` reassignment.","Session ID binding (engine.go:2232-2235): after start, if agentSession.CurrentSessionID() is non-empty, session.CompareAndSetAgentSessionID is called and sessions.Save(). The ID is therefore recorded after the session starts, not before.","Back in processInteractiveMessageWith: state.agentSession is used at 1952 (LiveModeSwitcher), 1985 (drainEvents), and 2000 (Send in a goroutine). Pending messages are not touched on this path until the end, at 2013.","Drain point 1, drainPendingMessages (engine.go:2931-2945+): loops under state.mu, pops pendingMessages[0] (2939-2940), then unlocks session and returns true when the queue is empty (2934-2937). Called from processInteractiveMessageWith at 2013 as a guard for orphaned messages after processInteractiveEvents returns.","Drain point 2, inline dequeue in processInteractiveEvents (engine.go:2776-2779): under state.mu, pops pendingMessages[0] and continues the event loop for the next turn. Sends at 2810. This does not call drainPendingMessages.","Drain point 3, engine.go:1625-1640: a busy-session path looks up e.interactiveStates[interactiveKey] (1630-1631). If the state or agentSession is missing or dead, it calls notifyDroppedQueuedMessages (2913-2920) and returns. Otherwise it calls drainPendingMessages at 1640.","Enqueue side: engine.go:1577-1594 checks state.agentSession != nil && Alive(), then appends to state.pendingMessages (cap maxQueuedMessages at 1590). Messages are only queued for a state that already has a live agent session."],"confidence":0.8}
